title: Bayesian Sparse Low-Rank Adaptation for Large Language Model Uncertainty Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2607.02182v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit remarkable reasoning capabilities, but their task-specific fine-tuning is notoriously plagued by overconfidence, severely hindering trustworthy deployment. We propose Data-Adaptive Lower-Rank Adaptation (DALorRA), a simple and effective variational Bayesian sparse framework that shifts the paradigm of uncertainty quantification from the dense parameter space to the lightweight rank level of low-rank adaptation (LoRA). With the insight that LoRA essentially aggregates multiple rank-one components that may provide superfluous model capacity, DALorRA imposes stochastic masking on rank dimensions, enabling Bayesian regularization of model capacity during training and ensemble-like calibration during inference. Extensive experiments demonstrate DALorRA's excellent calibration of LLMs without compromising reasoning accuracy.

translated_title: 面向大语言模型不确定性估计的贝叶斯稀疏低秩自适应方法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）展现出卓越的推理能力，但其任务特定的微调却因过度自信问题而广受诟病，严重阻碍了可信赖的部署应用。我们提出了数据自适应低秩自适应（DALorRA），这是一个简单而有效的变分贝叶斯稀疏框架，它将不确定性量化的范式从稠密参数空间转移到低秩自适应（LoRA）的轻量级秩层面。基于LoRA本质上是聚合多个秩一分量、从而可能提供充足模型容量的这一洞察，DALorRA对秩维度施加随机掩码，在训练过程中实现模型容量的贝叶斯正则化，并在推理过程中实现类似集成的校准。大量实验表明，DALorRA在不损害大语言模型推理精度的前提下，展现出优异的校准性能。
tldr: 提出DALorRA——一个变分贝叶斯稀疏框架，通过在LoRA的秩维度上施加随机掩码，将不确定性量化从稠密参数空间转移到轻量级的秩层面，从而在不损害推理精度的情况下实现大语言模型的优异校准。
en_tdlr: DALorRA is a simple yet effective variational Bayesian sparse framework that shifts uncertainty quantification from the dense parameter space to the lightweight rank level of LoRA by imposing stochastic masking on rank dimensions, achieving excellent calibration of LLMs without compromising reasoning accuracy.
